description: This file contains the FastAPI routes and handlers for managing events, data sources, timelines, and related metadata within the Fan Engagement Management System. It implements CRUD operations, validation, business rules, and publishes events to Kafka, with integration to MongoDB helpers.

classes.name: EventMetadataCreateModel
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating or updating event metadata with validation rules and business logic enforcement.

classes.name: EventDataSourceModel

classes.name: EventMetadataModel
classes.description: Model representing event metadata, imported from models.py.

classes.name: EventTimelineModel
classes.description: Model representing event timelines, imported from models.py.
